intent: Qualify production model comparisons only when their effective admitted conversation and follow-up inputs match, with unfrozen persistent memory explicitly unavailable.
behavior: Version gateway.github-intelligence-case.v2 is returned and included in the case-contract digest. Legacy unversioned opaque contracts cannot qualify the current aggregate score or comparison.

The exact effective job.get('conversation_context') JSON value is locally hashed with a versioned schema. Absent and explicit null both mean null; ordered roles, contents, revisions and coverage flags remain represented.

The exact effective data.get('user_instructions', []) JSON value is locally hashed with a versioned schema. Absence and [] match; explicit null, command identities, contents and order remain distinct.

Only explicit SESSION_ONLY qualifies this comparison contract until persistent historical inputs can be frozen and proven. Default, HYBRID and PERSISTENT remain unqualified rather than receiving a zero or failed model score.

Existing per-case observations remain available. Runtime memory preferences, provider requests, prompts, dispatch authority, budgets, acceptance, scenario weights and model execution remain unchanged.
No raw conversation or follow-up text is added to reports, score exports or diagnostics. Only an already hashed case contract and its schema marker are returned.
Comparison refusal retains the original error prefix and adds actionable session-only and matching-input guidance.

validation.permitted: Actual ordinary Python helper tests and static Git/source preservation; no Android, Kotlin, native, application substitute harness or provider execution.

test_first_context.explanation: Eight context/presence rejection subcases plus legacy opaque-contract compatibility failed against unchanged base production.

test_first_memory_and_instructions.explanation: Three unfrozen-memory modes and four changed/present-null follow-up subcases failed before the adjacent guards.

validation.prior_method_preservation: All nine prior score test method bodies and assertions remain byte-identical. The shared synthetic report helper now explicitly selects SESSION_ONLY for valid comparison fixtures and supports controlled context/instruction inputs.
validation.test_inventory: Six new score methods cover matched context under distinct external IDs, role/content/order/revision/coverage changes, absence/null/present-empty semantics, legacy schema refusal, unfrozen memory and exact sent follow-up inputs.
validation.scope_limit: Focused tests use controlled job observations and the actual pure Python score/compare/target helpers. They do not establish live-model quality, provider execution, device performance or universal superiority.

integration_requirements: Root owns composition onto the latest public head, preserving all concurrent commits.
Refresh the Gateway manifest and source anchor, mapped source references and exact additive release scope after composition.
Run canonical validation and every applicable current-head/main workflow before merge and publication.
The existing policy vocabulary, native context and other owner holds remain separate; this component clears none of their gates.
Final source, logs, input hashes, immutable commit/tree and independent review belong to separate receipts; this ledger is not self-attestation of publication.
